title: Pure Shiranui
summary: Pure Shiranui FIRE Zombie Synchro deck built around banishing archetype monsters to trigger cascading removal, recursion, and stat modulation. Every Shiranui monster unleashes its true power when banished, converting banished resources into lethal Synchro climbs and complete Special Summon locks.

summary.title: Starters
points: Shiranui Solitaire tributes a Zombie monster on your field to Special Summon a Zombie Tuner with 0 DEF directly from your Deck.
Shiranui Squire Normal Summons a Shiranui Spectralsword monster directly from your hand or Deck, and draws 1 card then discards 1 card when banished.
Ghost Meets Girl - A Shiranui's Story discards a Zombie monster to Special Summon a Shiranui monster with a different name from your Deck or GY.
Shiranui Spectralsword banishes itself and 1 non-Tuner Zombie monster from your GY during your turn to Special Summon a Zombie Synchro Monster with a Level equal to their combined Levels.

summary.title: Opening: Shiranui Solitaire
steps: Normal Summon Shiranui Solitaire and tribute it to Special Summon Shiranui Spectralsword from your Deck.
Alternatively, Normal Summon Shiranui Squire to Special Summon Shiranui Spectralsword from your hand or Deck.
Synchro Summon Shiranui Samuraisaga or Shiranui Squiresaga using Squire and Spectralsword.
Trigger Squire's banish effect or Spectralsword's GY setup to prepare GY banish plays for the following turn.
Set Shiranui Style Swallow's Slash or Ghost Meets Girl - A Masterful Mayakashi Shiranui Saga to disrupt the opponent on their turn.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Shiranui Sunsaga returns any number of your banished Zombie Synchro Monsters to the Extra Deck on summon to destroy that many cards your opponent controls without targeting, and protects Zombies from destruction by banishing a Shiranui from the GY.
Shiranui Shogunsaga banishes a Zombie monster from your GY on Synchro Summon to gain ATK equal to that monster's original ATK, and targets a banished Zombie to return it to the GY when destroyed.

Shiranui Skillsaga Supremacy is a Link-3 boss that makes your Synchro Monsters indestructible by battle and protects FIRE monsters from card effect destruction, while Special Summoning banished Zombie Synchros during your opponent's turn.
Shiranui Squiresaga banishes a face-up monster you control to gain 600 ATK, destroy 1 Spell or Trap, and destroy 1 monster without targeting based on the banished monster's card type.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Ghost Meets Girl - A Masterful Mayakashi Shiranui Saga tributes a Mayakashi or Shiranui Synchro or Link Monster to lock both players out of Special Summoning monsters from the hand, Deck, and Extra Deck for the rest of the turn.
Shiranui Style Swallow's Slash tributes a Zombie monster to destroy 2 cards on the field, then banishes a Shiranui monster from your Deck to trigger its banish effect.
Shiranui Style Synthesis and Shiranui Style Solemnity revive 0 DEF Zombies onto an empty field or grant summon protection and banish triggers.
Shiranui Style Success Special Summons a Zombie monster from your hand and banishes itself from the GY to make a Zombie monster unaffected by card effects.

allow.Ghost Meets Girl - A Masterful Mayakashi: Names Shiranui: tributes a Shiranui Synchro or Link Monster.

Shiranui Swordmaster
Revives itself next to two Shiranui; pumps a Zombie when banished.
Shiranui Style Synthesis
Field Spell: revives a 0-DEF Zombie onto an empty board.
Shiranui Style Solemnity
Counts as Synthesis; makes Zombie summons unnegatable or banishes one.
Ghost Meets Girl - A Shiranui's Story

Shiranui Style Success

Tributes a Zombie to destroy two cards; banishes a Shiranui from the Deck.
